description: DESCRIPTION The Global Solutions Risk and Compliance (GSRC) team ensures that Amazon transactions satisfy legal and safety requirements in accordance to the guidelines across global marketplaces. We proactively identify risks involved for Amazon while doing business in various countries and enable smooth flow of products across international borders. A Sr. Compliance Associate(DE) is responsible for protecting Amazon customers from products that are illegal, hazardous, unsafe, or otherwise prohibited /regulated by Law and Amazon policies. Key job responsibilities As a Sr. Compliance Associate(DE), your responsibility is reviewing the latest product information as per Standard Operations Procedures (SOP) and cross-checking it against the relevant regulatory documentation. Using various Amazon-specific tools and systems you classify the products to ensure they meet the necessary compliance requirements for availability on Amazon. Throughout the day, you work closely with your manager and the Process Experts and address any deviations from standard SOPs, seeking their guidance when necessary. You maintain detailed records of your assigned tasks and utilize standardized reports to prioritize your work, ensuring you meet Quality, Productivity and Service Level Agreement targets. You may identify opportunities for improvement and collaborate with partner teams to explore ways to reduce manual effort, such as automating reports using Excel queries. You share feedback on the team's SOPs, contributing to the ongoing refinement of the operational processes. You participate in knowledge-sharing sessions, contributing with your expertise and learnings. As a mentor, you may support peers by answering their queries and providing process-level training. Skills: Ability to use Microsoft Excel tool as per role requirements (filtering and sorting in data sets, cell referencing, pivot tables, data validation, etc.) Basic understanding of SQL, can self-service defined queries and make simple changes to retrieve data from a database Knowledgeable in Customer Relationship Management tools, managing customer data and tracking interactions Attention to detail and ability to analyze and identify patterns across data sets and information Problem-solving skills, with the ability to find solutions through logic, intuition, creativity, and design thinking Commitment to investigation, research, and diving deep to seek facts Ability to understand, interpret, critique, analyses and communicate data About the team Amazon is an E-commerce and Cloud Computing company with headquarters in Seattle, Washington. Since 1995, Amazon has focused on being “the world’s most customer centric company.” Our customers are worldwide, and include not just consumers, but also our sellers and vendors (selling partners). World-class retail brands and individual sellers increase their sales and reach new customers by leveraging the power of the Amazon e-commerce platform. To meet our selling partners’ needs, our smart, diverse, customer-obsessed employees are constantly innovating and building on new ideas. The Operational Risk Compliance (ORC) organization exists to keep our customers and partners safe, protect associates, and ensure legal and regulatory compliance. We coordinate the aspects of product transactions that are regulated (distribution, shipping, sale, and import/export). Global Solutions and Risk Compliance (GSRC) is the operational arm of the ORC organization. This involves analyzing product import documentation and flagging hazardous risks. We are also responsible for keeping Amazon customers safe and informed by coordinating actions around worldwide program teams to classify products and ensure Amazon’s product listings follow regulatory and legal compliance guidelines. These actions include removing products from the site and from our warehouses, and contacting customers with pertinent sustainability information. The ORC team partners with GSRC supports regulatory compliance requirements for Amazon’s worldwide programs such as Dangerous Goods, Global Trade Services, Transport Risk Compliance, Sustainability, Extended Producer Responsibility and Food Safety. GSRC has offices across India, China, Poland, Romania, Jordan, Philippines and Costa Rica and supports compliance related needs for worldwide Amazon marketplaces. description: Work Schedule Standard (Mon-Fri) Environmental Conditions Office Job Description Associate Analyst – Supply Chain Planning Systems (Kinaxis) About Thermo Fisher Scientific At Thermo Fisher Scientific, everything we do begins with our Mission — to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. As a global leader in serving science, we deliver innovative solutions that impact healthcare, life sciences, and research worldwide. Our values — Integrity, Intensity, Innovation, and Involvement — shape how we work together. Role Overview We are looking for a curious, analytical graduate with a real interest in how supply chains work to join our Supply Chain IT team as an Associate Analyst supporting Kinaxis Maestro, our supply chain planning platform . Kinaxis Maestro (formerly RapidResponse) is where our planners balance demand, supply, inventory, and capacity across Thermo Fisher's global network. When a plan is wrong or the system is unavailable, products that customers rely on for research, diagnostics, and therapies can be delayed. In this role, you will help keep that platform reliable, accurate, and trusted by the planners who use it every day . You will start by learning planning processes and the system alongside experienced Kinaxis specialists , and then progressively take ownership of production support, configuration changes, testing, and user enablement . No prior Kinaxis or work experience is expected — we will train you. What we need from you are strong fundamentals: logical thinking, comfort with data, clear communication, and the drive to learn a specialist platform in depth. This is an excellent opportunity for a recent graduate who wants to build a career at the intersection of supply chain planning, enterprise technology, data, and AI . How You Will Grow in Your First Year Months 0–3 | Learn: Structured onboarding on supply chain planning fundamentals (demand, supply, inventory, S&OP) and Kinaxis Maestro basics; complete Kinaxis Learning Center training; shadow the support team on live tickets. Months 3–6 | Contribute: Resolve routine user queries and support tickets under guidance; build and modify simple worksheets, filters, and alerts; execute test scripts for enhancements and releases. Months 6–12 | Own: Independently handle defined categories of support tickets; analyze recurring issues and propose permanent fixes; support a small enhancement end-to-end, from requirement to deployment. Key Responsibilities Provide first- and second-line support to planners using Kinaxis Maestro — log, analyze, resolve or route issues, and track them through closure within agreed service levels. Monitor daily data loads, scheduled jobs, and planning refreshes; flag failures and data gaps early to the right teams. Learn and apply core planning concepts — demand planning, supply planning, master production scheduling, inventory and capacity planning, and S&OP. Help configure and maintain Kinaxis workbooks, worksheets, filters, alerts, dashboards, and scenarios. Work with planners to understand business problems and translate them into clear requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria. Prepare and execute test scenarios for enhancements, fixes, and Kinaxis version releases; log and track defects to closure. Investigate planning results that do not look right — trace them back to master data, transactional data, or configuration, and explain the root cause in plain language. Collaborate with ERP (SAP, Oracle JD Edwards, Oracle Cloud SCM) and integration teams to understand how data flows into and out of Kinaxis. Create and maintain support runbooks, knowledge articles, user guides, and training material. Follow change control, documentation, and compliance practices required in a regulated (GxP) life sciences environment. Explore how analytics, automation, and AI can reduce repetitive support effort and help planners make faster, better decisions. What We Look For Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering (Industrial, Production, Mechanical, Computer Science, IT), Operations, Supply Chain, or a related discipline. Coursework, projects, or a strong interest in operations management, supply chain, or production planning. Strong analytical and structured problem-solving ability — comfortable breaking a messy problem into logical steps. Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel (formulas, lookups, pivot tables) and comfort working with numbers and large data sets. Basic understanding of data concepts such as tables, keys, and joins. Clear written and verbal communication, and the confidence to ask questions. Attention to detail and a sense of ownership — following an issue through until it is resolved. Flexibility to occasionally support global users across time zones. Good to have Academic or project exposure to planning concepts such as MRP, MPS, safety stock, lead time, or S&OP. Basic SQL skills for querying and validating data. Exposure to any ERP system (SAP, Oracle) through coursework, a lab, or an internship. Exposure to a BI tool (Power BI, Tableau) or Python for data analysis. Awareness of Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs) and how they could be applied to business problems. Supply chain case competitions, simulation games, or ASCM (APICS) coursework. An internship or live project involving operations, process improvement, or data analysis. Leadership or organizing experience in a technical club, student chapter, or college fest. Why join us Competitive salary with annual performance-based bonus. Comprehensive medical insurance covering you, your spouse, children, and dependent parents. Structured onboarding, a 12-month learning plan, and a dedicated mentor for your first six months. Sponsored Kinaxis Maestro training and certification through the Kinaxis Learning Center. Hands-on exposure to how a global life sciences supply chain plans and delivers. Clear career progression into Kinaxis Functional Consultant, Planning Solution Architect, Supply Chain Business Analyst, or Product Owner tracks. Access to Thermo Fisher's global learning platform. Hybrid working model with flexible hours. Employee wellness programs, on-campus recreational facilities, and mental health support. Paid time off, parental leave, and company-paid holidays. Opportunity to work with global teams across the US, Europe, and APAC.

description: Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers. The mission - Product Support at Sprinto is not about forwarding queries or closing as many tickets as possible. It is about understanding why something is not working and helping the customer move forward with confidence. When a customer encounters an integration failure, unexpected API behaviour, configuration issue or confusing product workflow, you will investigate the problem, identify what is happening and own the issue through resolution. You will work with browser developer tools, APIs, integrations, logs and cloud environments. You will also collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Customer Success and Compliance teams. You will develop technical depth while learning how a global SaaS product operates in real customer environments. Where you'll leave your mark? Reproduce problems, test hypotheses and identify the most likely cause. Become fluent in modern SaaS systems : Develop practical knowledge of APIs, HTTP requests, browser behaviour, authentication, cloud integrations and the systems that connect Sprinto with a customer's technology environment. Own the customer's experience: Communicate clearly throughout the investigation. Work closely with Product and Engineering: Collect the right evidence, isolate issues and create precise escalations that help engineering teams act quickly. Over time, you will learn to distinguish between product defects, configuration problems, integration failures and expected behaviour. Improve more than one interaction: Identify recurring patterns and turn them into better documentation, troubleshooting playbooks, product feedback or process improvements.
